plugin.description: Send messages to approved chats using Beeper, iMessage, WhatsApp, Telegram, or Android SMS.

actions.name: send_message
actions.description: Send plain text to an allowed chat on an enabled connection. Only send when the user explicitly asks. Use list_chats to find exact chat_id values. When a name matches multiple chats or connections, ask the user which one; never guess or fall back to another connection. Direct iMessage and Android SMS support individuals only.

recipient.description: The approved contact, group name, nickname, or exact chat ID/address.

text.description: The exact message requested by the user.

operation_id.description: Optional unique operation ID. Reuse it when retrying the same send.

chat_id.description: Exact account-and-connection-bound ID returned by list_chats; use it to disambiguate the destination.

connection.description: Optional connection ID to limit name resolution.

actions.name: list_chats
actions.description: List only the chats the user has allowed on enabled connections, including names, nicknames, network badges, and exact chat_id values for send_message. Ask the user to choose when multiple chats match. This does not search the address book or expose unapproved chats.
